title: The ET-SoC-1, interactively
description: An interactive, animated schematic of Esperanto's ET-SoC-1 for presenting: the die with its mesh of shires, a shire's cache and minions, a minion's units, and six data flows (a load to DRAM, the latency ladder, TensorSend, the relay, gathers and scatters, the host over PCIe) with the latency, bandwidth and energy measured on three cards, each number with its source; a 12-step tour for the stage.
